description: CoinbaseCartel is a medium-sophisticated criminal threat actor specializing in data exfiltration through system access and strategic partnerships. Primarily motivated by financial gain, they focus on stealing sensitive information without disrupting operations or encrypting systems, targeting various sectors to maximize ransom demands. With numerous campaigns identified across industries like finance, healthcare, and retail, CoinbaseCartel poses a persistent risk to organizations seeking valuable data.
